_about: Research configuration register (owner rule 8, 11-Nov-2026). One entry per market x strategy x timeframe. Parameters are SHARED defaults unless an instrument-level override has evidence; as of 11-Nov-2026 NO instrument-level override has enough evidence, so none is set. Production alert settings are NOT here and are not changed by this file.
evidence_rule_for_instrument_override: per-instrument parameters only if the instrument alone passes the period gate (>= 30 trades in each of DEV / VALID / OOS, profit and PF >= 1.2 each) AND beats the shared default in OOS AND survives BH-FDR across all instruments tested. Current status: 3 of 14,535 MCX per-commodity cells passed the gate, 0 passed FDR -> no overrides.
